test_title: PYST 20: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students A, B, C, D, E and F are standing facing north but not necessarily in the same sequence. A is at one of the corners and F is beside him. B is to the immediate right of E. B is second from the right end. C is not beside F. Who is standing third from the left?
solution:
Persons: A, B, C, D, E and F

1) B is to the immediate right of E

2) B is second from the right end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbf55db1d2638ddbe46244f697cfdc8b5a771f6d4aa0b5cc54a4c6fff392bdb9.png] 

3) A is at one of the corners and F is beside him.
